BEFORE THE FIRST CUT

A small check.
A clean print.

1

Check the paper settings

Use portrait, actual size / 100%, and turn browser headers and footers off.

2

Try one sheet first

Printer alignment varies. Download the numbered test, print it double-sided, and hold it to a light. Matching numbers should sit behind each other.

3

Print, then cut

The file alternates questions and answers for each sheet. Open it in a desktop browser, then print or save as PDF. It also works offline.

No printer is connected to this app. Nothing prints until you choose it in your browser.

Start a fresh deck?
